text.37:45: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
text.43:71: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
text.52:24: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
text.55:44: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.
text.56:17: There wait on them immortal youths
text.68:19: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
text.76:15: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
text.76:19: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
